title: Vishwakarma Jayanti 2026
author: Editorial Desk
summary: Preparing for 17 September: tools, workshops and a thought.
body:
This week, BMS units, workshops and factories prepare for **Vishwakarma Jayanti on 17 September**, which BMS observes as the National Labour Day.

## What happens

- **Cleaning and decoration** of workshops, factories and offices.
- **Puja of tools and machines.**
- **Cultural programmes** and community meals.
- Speeches that recall Thengadi Ji's argument for an Indian day of labour.

## A thought for the day

*Vishwa* means world and *karma* means work. The name itself says that **work builds the world**. It is a view of labour that respects skill, and one that sees the artisan as a creator.

## Practical ideas for unions

- Honour **long-serving workers and apprentices**.
- Hold a **safety check** of machines on this day.
- Collect **suggestions** from workers about improving the workplace.
- Organise **blood donation or health check-ups**.

## For employers

Give workers time to take part. A workplace that celebrates its work is a workplace that wants to do it well.
